main_issue: The group conflates absent authentication before a privileged effect with authentication bypasses caused by trusting attacker-controlled request metadata. The OneDev case has a localhost guard, but it is bypassable because X-Forwarded-For is treated as authoritative; it is not simply a missing authentication check. The BlueBubbles example lacks mechanism evidence sufficient to establish that it shares either shape.
suggested_guideline: For externally reachable callback, webhook, or management endpoints that are intended to be restricted to localhost or a trusted proxy, trace how the client origin is derived before privileged commands or state changes occur. Report paths that authorize access from attacker-controlled forwarding headers, unvalidated proxy metadata, or other spoofable origin signals. Require a trusted-proxy boundary and derive the peer address from a transport-controlled source; do not use client-supplied forwarding headers as the sole localhost or authentication decision.
split_suggestions: Spoofable origin or trusted-proxy metadata used to bypass localhost-only callback protection
Privileged externally reachable actions with no authentication or principal-validation guard on the source-to-sink path
evidence_notes: CVE-2022-39205 explicitly checks loopback status before Git-hook command execution, but obtains the address from X-Forwarded-For when present; an attacker can spoof that header and satisfy the guard.
The OneDev safe fix should establish a trusted proxy boundary or use transport-derived peer identity, rather than only adding a generic session/token check.

CVE-2026-8305 provides only review-entry provenance and an anchor named local bypass; it contains no source, sink, guard, exploit precondition, or fix evidence to support assignment to this mechanism.

The cluster summary also includes timing comparisons, rate limiting, pre-auth body parsing, replay protection, secret rotation, routing, and concurrency issues; these require separate mechanism groups rather than a single missing-authentication guideline.
